**Top pick: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Magnetic Charging Station (Qi2.2, 25 W)**

- **Buy:** [ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 at ESR's US store (via Dealectric)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)
- **Price:** Dealectric reports $99.99 (list $129.99), or about $82 with code PARTNER18, which it says it tested in ESR's cart on 2026-10-23. Codes change, so confirm the price at checkout.
- **Why it fits:** It charges the iPhone at up to 25 W with an active cooling fan, plus an Apple Watch pad and a Qi pad for AirPods. A 50 W adapter is included. Warranty is 12 months (24 with free ESR registration), with 30-day returns.
- **Caveat:** The 25 W rate applies only to the iPhone 17 series, iPhone 16 Pro Max, and iPhone 16 Plus (iOS 26). The iPhone Air, 16, and 16 Pro get 20 W, and older iPhones get 15 W.
- **Disclosure:** This is an affiliate page. Dealectric earns a commission if you buy through that link, at no extra cost to you. The review is based on the site's own testing and its own specs, so treat the code and claims as provisional until checked.

Source: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)

**Other good options**

- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W ($129.99):** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested. It suits desk use, folds for travel, and includes a 45 W adapter. It weighs 399 g, so it's heavier than the others. Macworld's review lists retailer prices but no direct buy link: [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **Nimble Podium 3-in-1 (about $130 on Amazon):** Its flat design suits nightstands, and it supports Qi2 25 W for the iPhone. WIRED notes that Apple Watch charging is slow, so it's best left overnight. The results don't include a store link: [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Nomad Stand One Max ($169):** It has 25 W iPhone charging and a classy design, but no power adapter is included. You need a 40 W adapter (Nomad's is $25). Source: [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Budget picks (15 W, not 25 W):** WIRED's "Best Overall" Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 stand was listed at $98 on sale. Its "Best Cheap" ESR Qi2 3-in-1 was listed at $40 on sale. Both charge the iPhone at 15 W. Source: [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Choosing between them**

- For the fastest iPhone charging, pick a 25 W model and check that your iPhone supports it.
- For travel, pick a folding model such as the ESR CryoBoost or Satechi. WIRED's travel guide lists the ESR CryoBoost at about $100 on Amazon: [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)
- If you mostly charge overnight, 15 W is usually fine, and it's cheaper.

If you tell me your iPhone model, I can narrow this down to the best option for its charging speed.
